title: The Gilded Wolf
premise: Juniper Thackeray has spent her life translating the whispers of the dead into the Gilded Ledger, the guild's record of impossible trades — until she finds tonight's date inked in a century-old prophecy naming her as the one who 'unlocks the winter door.' The prophecy was authored by a bone-carver who sold her own soul to the court beneath the mountain, and that court now demands Juniper complete the bargain: deliver the ledger as the key to an endless winter. Refusing, Juniper gathers the guild's misfit debtors — a disgraced weather-witch, a mute giant, and the ghost of the prophecy's author — and descends to steal back the dead woman's soul. In the court beneath the mountain, Juniper learns the prophecy's true price: a soul must stay behind to hold the winter door shut, and she chooses to bind herself in the author's place. But found family refuses the arithmetic of sacrifice; her companions shatter the ledger itself, erasing the debt rather than paying it, and the guild is reborn around a new covenant: nothing with a soul is ever traded again.
about_author: Kestrel Nystrom is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing estate sales and swears half the ledgers whispered back. They write cold-country fantasy about people who bargain with things they shouldn't.

chapters.title: The Date That Wasn't There Yesterday
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. While balancing the guild's accounts, Juniper finds tonight's date in a sealed prophecy ledger and hears its dead author whisper her name. The guild master demands she surrender the book; instead she hides it and flees into the snow. Emotional beat: dread curdling into defiance as belonging to the guild starts to feel like being owned by it.

chapters.title: Debtors of the Impossible
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV, with interludes from the ghost Odile. Hunted by the guild's collectors, Juniper recruits those the ledger holds in debt: weather-witch Sable, the mute giant Bram, and Odile's restless spirit, who reveals the soul-sale beneath the mountain. Emotional beat: wary strangers becoming a fragile, chosen family over a shared enemy.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Odile's POV takes the descent, with Juniper close behind. The party bargains their way through the winter court's masque, where Odile's soul hangs caged as a chandelier. Juniper learns the prophecy's trap: closing the winter door requires a soul to remain. Emotional beat: terror and wonder braided together as the cost of victory comes due.

chapters.title: Nothing With a Soul
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. Offered freedom if she lets Odile pay the price, Juniper offers herself instead — but Sable, Bram, and even freed Odile tear the ledger apart, unmaking the debt itself. The winter door seals on erased paper; the guild rewrites its covenant above. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into joy as sacrifice is refused and family chooses itself.
